title: E-FRC-0062: the Koide assignment is grounded in the triality-sector geometry: within a sector the nearest-neighbour...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0062 in the gauge arena: the Koide assignment is grounded in the triality-sector geometry: within a sector the nearest-neighbour scale is the long root sqrt(2) and between sectors it is the short root 1, so the mass-operator ratio |c|/a = 1/sqrt(2) hence Q = 2/3 is selected by the nearest-neighbour scale reading, with the alternative pairings as controls giving wrong Q (max-based gives 5/6), resting on the sector-to-generation identification (Boyle) and the load-bearing nearest-neighbour choice.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
